This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|green]] and tan skin,<ref name="The Acolyte" /> lacking visible [[Nose|nostrils]], with black [[eye]]s, and an elongated cranium with fin-like growths covered in darkened stripes protruding from the sides.<ref name="Andor" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Noseless-Species-Wedding.png|thumb|left|200px|A member of this species attended the wedding of Leida Mothma and Stekan Sculdun]]
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="The Acolyte Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> at least one member of this species was present at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="The Acolyte" /> Much later, in [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Andor Date">{{Andor|One Year Later}} dates the first arc of [[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' 2]] to [[4 BBY]].</ref> another member of this species was in attendance at the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding ceremony]] of [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on [[Chandrila]].<ref name="Andor" /> Two years later, at least one member of this species frequented the [[Imperial Senate Building]],<ref name="Messenger">{{Andor|Messenger}}</ref> witnessing [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Escape from the Senate|escape from the Senate]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Teach / Corrupt|sixth episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Hanelle M. Culpepper]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />
